professionalSummary: Adobe Certified Expert (ACE) and results-driven AEM Developer with 4+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling enterprise CMS solutions across AEM 6.5 and AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS). Hands-on expertise spanning Java, OSGi, Apache Sling, Sling Models, Sling Servlets, HTL, JCR/Oak, GraphQL, and REST API integrations - with a strong foundation in headless architecture, component design, backend service development, and multi-region deployment. Demonstrated ability to independently own high-stakes technical challenges end-to-end: from leading legacy CMS-to-cloud migrations and building AI-assisted automation tooling, to architecting secure third-party integrations and diagnosing critical production vulnerabilities under tight deadlines. Consistent record of zero-defect releases and high deployment success rates across global EU, APAC, and US platforms.

positions.title: Developer 2
highlights: Driving a large-scale CMS modernization program for the Citi ThankYou Rewards platform, migrating static content from TeamSite CMS to AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS) by mapping legacy DCTs to Content Fragment Models and DCRs to Content Fragments; independently built an AI-assisted migration accelerator (Cursor AI) that analyzes existing repository patterns to auto-generate CFMs, CFs, and GraphQL persisted queries through a guided preview-and-approve workflow, cutting manual effort and accelerating delivery.

Designed scalable Content Fragment Models and GraphQL persisted queries powering headless content delivery for the Next.js front end across key rewards experiences - including Points Transfer, Points Summary, Order History, Cash PDP, Charity, FAQ, and Account Combine - collaborating closely with front-end, architecture, and business teams through CMS design reviews and API design sessions to define content structures and API contracts.

Implemented bilingual (English/Spanish) content delivery and a structured AEM tag taxonomy (tier, session state, active status, and language tags) to enable audience-based content targeting and consistent metadata across Content Fragments.

Shaped GraphQL responses to match UI contracts - aligning field order to page layout, normalizing rich-text/HTML output, and resolving encoding differences between GraphiQL and publish endpoints - and validated persisted queries in Postman before exposing publish endpoints to the front-end team.

Managed deployments through Adobe Cloud Manager CI/CD pipelines, troubleshooting FileVault filter.xml modes and package installation behavior to ensure CFM and persisted-query updates reflected correctly across Author and Publish environments.

Led the EU-AMEA website redesign initiative, delivering 10+ reusable, multi-variant AEM components across 15+ regional sites spanning US, EU, and APAC regions - achieving zero production defects and measurably improving page load performance and author experience.

Built a secure, service-oriented third-party payment integration on AEM using OAuth 2.0, implementing environment-specific OSGi configurations across Dev, QA, Stage, and Production environments with structured JSON response handling and full sandbox-to-live promotion support.

Sole developer credited with independently diagnosing and remediating a critical production data exposure vulnerability - executing the full fix cycle from root-cause analysis to deployment within 5 business days, safeguarding live customer data across multiple regional platforms.

Orchestrated 24+ biweekly post-production enhancement releases across EU and APAC regions, consistently achieving high deployment success rates with zero rollbacks through rigorous pre-release validation and post-production monitoring.

Designed and tuned Oak/Lucene index configurations to optimize full-text and property-based search queries across the JCR repository, reducing query execution time and improving AEM content delivery performance.

positions.title: Developer 1

Stepped up during the absence of senior team members, supporting planning and execution of 3 major production releases with zero defects - demonstrating technical ownership and cross-functional coordination under pressure.

Developed a site-wide Simplified Header Footer (SHF) solution leveraging locale-based Sling Model injection, standardizing header/footer rendering across all regional sites and eliminating content inconsistency issues at scale.
